files_summary.state.json: Initial scenario state for the Keystone Runtime State & Math Service MathAPI (Math API).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: absolute_value
tool_schemas.description: Computes the absolute (non-negative) value of the provided number and returns the resulting numeric value. It refuses requests that omit the required "number" field or provide a value that is not a valid number.

number.description: The number to calculate the absolute value of.

tool_schemas.name: add
tool_schemas.description: Adds the two provided numbers and returns their sum. It refuses requests that omit either required operand ("a" or "b") or provide values that are not valid numbers.

tool_schemas.name: divide
tool_schemas.description: Divides "a" by "b" and returns the quotient. It refuses requests that omit either required operand, provide non-numeric values, or attempt to divide by zero because the result is undefined.

tool_schemas.name: imperial_si_conversion
tool_schemas.description: Converts the given numeric "value" from "unit_in" to "unit_out" and returns the converted numeric value. It refuses requests missing any required field, with a non-numeric "value", or with unsupported/unknown unit strings or incompatible unit pairs that cannot be converted between each other.

unit_out.description: Unit to convert the value to.

tool_schemas.name: logarithm
tool_schemas.description: Computes the logarithm of "value" in the specified "base" using the requested precision and returns the resulting numeric value. It refuses requests missing required fields, with non-numeric inputs, with a non-positive precision, with a non-positive base or base equal to 1, or with a non-positive value where the real logarithm is not defined.

value.description: The number to compute the logarithm of.

tool_schemas.name: max_value
tool_schemas.description: Returns the maximum value from the provided list of numbers. It refuses requests that omit "numbers", provide an empty list, or include items that are not valid numbers.

numbers.description: List of numbers to find the maximum from.

tool_schemas.name: mean
tool_schemas.description: Calculates and returns the arithmetic mean of the provided list of numbers. It refuses requests that omit "numbers", provide an empty list, or include items that are not valid numbers.

numbers.description: List of numbers to calculate the mean of.

tool_schemas.name: min_value
tool_schemas.description: Returns the minimum value from the provided list of numbers. It refuses requests that omit "numbers", provide an empty list, or include items that are not valid numbers.

numbers.description: List of numbers to find the minimum from.

tool_schemas.name: multiply
tool_schemas.description: Multiplies the two provided numbers and returns their product. It refuses requests that omit either required operand ("a" or "b") or provide values that are not valid numbers.

tool_schemas.name: percentage
tool_schemas.description: Calculates (part / whole) * 100 and returns the percentage value. It refuses requests that omit either required field, provide non-numeric values, or set "whole" to zero because the percentage would be undefined.

tool_schemas.name: power
tool_schemas.description: This tool belongs to the Math API, which provides various mathematical operations. Tool description: Raise a number to a power. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

tool_schemas.name: round_number
tool_schemas.description: Rounds the provided number to the requested number of decimal places and returns the rounded value. Refuses requests missing the required number, with a non-integer decimal_places, or with values that are not valid finite numbers. Refuses decimal_places values outside the supported range for rounding precision.

decimal_places.description: The number of decimal places to round to. Defaults to 0.

tool_schemas.name: si_unit_conversion
tool_schemas.description: Converts the given numeric value from unit_in to unit_out and returns the converted value. Refuses requests missing value, unit_in, or unit_out, with a value that is not a valid finite number, or with unknown/unsupported unit strings. Refuses conversions between incompatible dimensions (for example, converting a length unit to a mass unit) or where the requested pair is not supported.

unit_out.description: Unit to convert the value to.

tool_schemas.name: square_root
tool_schemas.description: Computes the square root of number using the requested precision and returns the result. Refuses requests missing number or precision, with a non-integer or non-positive precision, or with a number that is not a valid finite number. Refuses negative input values because a real square root cannot be produced.

number.description: The number to calculate the square root of.

tool_schemas.name: standard_deviation
tool_schemas.description: Calculates the standard deviation of the provided list of numbers and returns the computed value. Refuses requests missing numbers, where numbers is not an array, or where any element is not a valid finite number. Refuses empty lists because a standard deviation cannot be computed without data.

numbers.description: List of numbers to calculate the standard deviation of.

tool_schemas.name: subtract
tool_schemas.description: Subtracts b from a and returns the numeric result. Refuses requests missing a or b, or where either value is not a valid finite number. Refuses inputs that cannot be safely represented as numbers.

tool_schemas.name: sum_values
tool_schemas.description: Sums the provided list of numbers and returns the total. Refuses requests missing numbers, where numbers is not an array, or where any element is not a valid finite number. Refuses inputs that cannot be safely represented as numbers.

metadata.name: Keystone Runtime State & Math Service
metadata.description: Stores lightweight shared runtime state and provides a simple API for common arithmetic, statistics, rounding, logarithms, roots, powers, percentages, and unit conversions.
